title: Hortus sanitatis : Livre IV, Les Poissons (De piscibus) — édition en ligne
institution: Université de Caen Normandie (Catherine Jacquemard, Brigitte Gauvin, Marie-Agnès Lucas-Avenel), Presses universitaires de Caen
notes: Online companion to the printed critical edition: the Latin Tractatus de piscibus (Book IV of the Hortus sanitatis, editio princeps by Meydenbach, Mainz 1491) with apparatus, a modern French translation, notes, an index and facsimiles of copies from Épernay and Valognes. Counts are ours: about 34,700 words of Latin text in the 108 chapter pages (notes, apparatus popups and French left out; the figure includes the quoted source passages and reference labels shown with the Latin, so it is approximate). The server shows the chapter pages last modified on 3 June 2022 and the home page on 10 January 2022, so it is listed as archived.
